name: ST Tau
description: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that pulsates every 4.03 days; its mean radius is 39 solar radii.

radius.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, ST Tau: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 39 +/- 3.9 (Monte-Carlo)

temperature.source: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 153, Name='ST Tau', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5750 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic)

distance.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, ST Tau: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1174.3 +/- 115 (Monte-Carlo)

color.reason: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.368 +/- 0.03 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation

text.card: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 39 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 4.0 days.
text.introduction: Its mean radius, 39 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,174 parsecs away.
text.locator: table10, ST Tau: Per, Rad, Dist

notes: The star pulsates; it is drawn at its mean radius.
No dynamical mass is measured for this Cepheid; its mass is left unmeasured.
